हेलो! मैंने Kuku FM (Android)  पर यह शो सुना और मुझे यकीन है कि आपको भी यह जरूर पसंद आएगा।

show.description: Humiliated as a lowly guard, Krish discovers he is the secret heir to a multi-billion dollar empire. To claim his legacy, he must survive a high-stakes corporate test while outsmarting the elites who once spat on him. From the gates of South Bombay to the halls of power, it’s a journey of absolute power and cold-blooded revenge.
